scope: Public mobile Matterport viewer; plain JavaScript, not React

confirmed_failure_paths.before: Each repeated same-model call restarted startup, cleared the SDK and navigated the same iframe through about:blank. Repeated startup also cleared UI readiness even though UI initialization runs once.
confirmed_failure_paths.after: One shared initialization promise per stable venue/model identity; completed sessions reuse the existing iframe, SDK and camera. Actual model changes create a new lifecycle epoch.

confirmed_failure_paths.before: Late SDK resolution or rejection could overwrite or clear a newer connection; configuration requests wrote shared model/key state while awaiting network responses.
confirmed_failure_paths.after: Local configuration results and SDK references commit only if the model identity, frame, source and lifecycle epoch are still current.

confirmed_failure_paths.before: Repeated script execution replaced startup state; late readiness could reopen loader DOM.
confirmed_failure_paths.after: Singleton module and boot guards; completion is retained until an actual model change or explicit failure.

confirmed_failure_paths.before: A route request could navigate an SDK that had connected but whose model startup was incomplete. Closing a queued request could hide the permanent background.
confirmed_failure_paths.after: Route requests join startup, closed requests cannot start later, and closing a preview preserves the permanent background.

controlled_duplicate_initialization_coun.case: Normal initial load, then two explicit same-model showBackground calls
controlled_duplicate_initialization_coun.interpretation: The confirmed reload reused the iframe element; it was an iframe document reload, not a React remount or full browser navigation.

normal_interaction_verification.real_sdk_route_test: Route calculation, Walkthrough, Next, Exit, automated preview and Exit passed with one iframe and one SDK initialization.
normal_interaction_verification.late_readiness_test: Repeated uiReady for the completed generation preserved completion and kept the loader hidden.

diagnostics.storage: Bounded in-memory event history; no network upload
events: document navigation type and supported discard flag
iframe identity, source revision and load
diagnostics.privacy: No credential values, URLs, search text, POI identifiers or raw error messages are retained.
diagnostics.failure_handling: SDK runtime errors stay visible. Explicit retry replaces the failed viewer session and restores its last confirmed scan/rotation where supported; there is no automatic reload loop.

remaining_limitations: The referenced 76-second recording was not available in attachments. Its spontaneous reload trigger was not reproduced by the normal baseline sequence; only the controlled repeated-initializer failure is confirmed.
Mobile profiles ran in Chromium with Apple Metal rendering. Physical Android Chrome and iPhone WebKit were not tested.

Some runs had an additional pre-readiness Matterport document navigation without a host source change or second SDK initialization. No such navigation occurred after readiness; the vendor-side initiator remains unconfirmed.
Cross-origin Matterport WebGL events cannot be observed directly by production parent-page JavaScript. The trace marks that limitation; SDK error phases are recorded and surfaced.
No mobile-memory-pressure cause was established. Successful browser runs had no WebGL context-loss event or runtime JavaScript exception.
